DAHLIA

I never asked to marry the devil.

But when Pietro Zanetti — Rome's most feared mafia heir — put a ring on my finger, he didn't just claim my body. He claimed my soul.

Every kiss burns. Every command destroys me.

He's my husband… and my captor.

And even when I should hate him, I can't stop craving the sin in his touch.

PIETRO

She was supposed to be my weakness.

Instead, she became my obsession.

In a world built on blood and betrayal, love is a liability — and Dahlia is the one secret I can't bury.

I'll protect her, possess her, and if anyone dares touch what's mine…

I'll burn the world to ashes.

This is Book 1 in the Dark Devotion Series. Reading Order: 

Dark Instinct, Dark Temptation, Dark Craving.
